subject: Dedicated capacity demo — QuantaEdge throughput triage

From: Samira Khan <samira@quantaedge.com>

Cc: eng-team@quantaedge.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo for latency-sensitive pipeline

Hi Neha,

We self-signed up and kicked the tires on Redwood's hosted API; results look promising, but we have a production window in Q3 and want to evaluate Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and tail-latency guarantees. Can we schedule a short technical demo focused on throughput profiles, autoscale behavior, and fallback routing?

Quick background: QuantaEdge runs a real-time inference pipeline for document enrichment (avg context 1.2k tokens) and expects steady QPS in the 120-250 range with occasional spikes to ~600 for short bursts. Latency target is p95 < 150ms for the 1k token window. Security/SOC2 posture is important; we'll want to cover private deployment options.

Available windows this week: Thu 6/30 9–11am PT, Fri 7/1 8–10am PT. If possible, include someone from the ops/infra team.

Thanks,
Samira
Head of ML Ops
QuantaEdge

Attachments: QEDGE_qps_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi Samira — thanks for the QPS summary (got the spreadsheet). A couple quick clarifying questions ahead of the demo so we can bring the right test harness and kernel/quantization recommendations: 

1) Typical sequence-length distribution: you said avg ~1.2k tokens — what's the 95th percentile?
2) Are the bursts to ~600 QPS sustained for longer than 60s or are they sub-30s spikes?
3) Do you need GPU isolation per-tenant (we can propose Dedicated with node-pinning) or is a shared Dedicated pool OK if logically isolated?
4) Any compliance constraints that require Private deployment rather than Hosted/Dedicated?

If you can reply with short answers, we can tailor the demo (and I can prepare a synthetic spike simulation using your sample prompts). I can run the session Thurs 6/30 at 9:30am PT or Fri 7/1 at 8:30am PT — prefer the first if it fits.

Best,
Karthik | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben/Karthik — confirmed Thurs 6/30 at 9:30am PT. Attendees: me (Samira), two infra engineers (Priyav, Marco) + one ML engineer (Jules).

Quick answers to Karthik's Qs: 
1) 95th percentile ~1.8k tokens (we have longer docs occasionally).
2) Spikes to ~600 are bursty but can last ~2–4 minutes during heavy ingestion windows; sustained >5 minutes is rare.
3) We'd prefer node-pinning (isolation) for the initial pilot; logical isolation is fine longer-term.
4) We are SOC2 compliant and likely will require Private deployment for audit evidence, but we want to validate Dedicated performance first.

I've attached a small sample of recent payloads and a one-page infra diagram. See attached: QEDGE_qps_summary.xlsx.

See you Thu at 9:30 — please include a short agenda in the calendar invite.

—Samira
